about: Picross: the numbers next to each row and column tell how many filled cells there are, in order. Fill the right cells to reveal a picture. Easy 5x5, Normal 8x8, Hard 10x10.
controls: Tap a cell to fill it, long-press or Cross mode to mark it empty. Drag to fill a line. Hint and Undo buttons on the right.
name: Nonogram
tagline: Fill the grid from the number clues to reveal a hidden picture.
